events.title: Canadian Stocks Poised To Rise On Commodity Strength
events.description: Canadian stocks are expected to move higher Thursday morning, supported by firm commodity prices and positive European market signals. Multiple companies report earnings, including Canadian Natural Resources, Bombardier, and Gildan Activewear, while investors await Friday's jobs data from Canada and the U.S.

events.title: Wall Street Likely To Open On Mixed Note
events.description: U.S. stocks are seen opening on a mixed note Thursday morning. Tech stocks are likely to be under pressure amid speculation the Democrats controlled Congress will possibly try to enforce greater regulation of the AI systems.

events.title: Bank Of England Lifts Interest Rate To 4%, First Hike In Over 3 Years
events.description: The U.K. central bank raised its key interest rate on Thursday, as expected, for the first time since 2023 in an attempt to cushion the future impact of the second-round effects of high energy prices and warned that more hikes would be necessary if the Middle East conflict does not resolve fast.

events.title: FTSE 100 Up 0.73%; BoE Raises Interest Rate By 25 Bps
events.description: U.K. stocks were up in positive territory a little past noon on Thursday with investors reacting to a slew of earnings announcements and digesting the Bank of England's decision to raise interest rate by 25 basis points.

events.title: CAC 40 Advances On Strong Earnings
events.description: French stocks gained some ground in positive territory Thursday morning, extending gains from the previous session, as worries about inflation and trade eased a bit, prompting investors to pick up shares. Some strong earnings updates contribute as well to the positive sentiment in the market.

events.title: Toyota Stock Climbs On Higher H1 Results, Profit Outlook Upgrade
events.description: Shares of Toyota Motor Corp. climbed around 17 percent in Japan trading and are currently trading around 9 percent higher in the pre-market activity on the NYSE, after the Japanese auto major on Thursday revised upward its fiscal 2027 outlook for net income and operating income, after reporting strong growth in first-half results. events.title: Indian Shares Extend Rally For Sixth Day
events.description: Indian shares rose sharply on Thursday, extending gains for a sixth consecutive session as global bond yields eased and Brent crude prices plummeted to $94 a barrel on hopes that the U.S.-Iran war could end soon.

events.title: DAX Hits Fresh Record High; Rheinmetall Tanks After Lowering 2026 Outlook
events.description:
German stocks climbed higher Thursday morning, lifting the benchmark DAX to a fresh record high in the process, as risk sentiment improved following the victory of the Democrats in the midterm elections easing trade concerns a bit. 

Oil's rebound from recent losses, and political tensions in France limited market's upside.

events.title: Gold Extends Gains To Two-week High
events.description: Gold prices extended gains to hit a more than two-week high on Thursday as the U.S. dollar and Treasury yields slipped following the U.S. midterm elections. A sharp retreat in oil prices also helped ease inflation and rate hike concerns.

events.title: German Factory Orders Rebound
events.description: Germany's factory orders rebounded in September largely driven by strong expansion in the automotive sector, official data revealed Thursday. Factory orders increased 4.4 percent on a monthly basis, in contrast to the revised 10.1 percent decline logged in August. However, the pace of growth was weaker than forecast of 4.6 percent.

events.title: Oil Rebounds From Two-month Lows
events.description: Oil prices traded higher on Thursday, after having fallen more than 8 percent in the previous session on hopes that the U.S.-Iran war could end soon.

events.title: European Shares Extend Gains As Inflation Concerns Ease
events.description: European stocks traded higher on Thursday, extending gains from the previous session as retreating energy costs helped ease inflation and rate hike concerns.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Rises Amid Risk-On Mood
events.description: The Canadian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday, as Asian stock markets traded higher, as traders react positively to the Democrats' decisive victory in the midterm elections after they won control of both the House and Senate, with crude oil prices plummeting on hopes of a potential end to the Middle East conflict.
